What was she like? What else did she love? What was her favorite treat? Did she have any hobbies? What really made her face light up with joy?”

segments.quote: In asking these kinds of questions we keep them here with us in story form. As long as someone is still here to speak their name, keep talking about them and insist “their life here on earth MATTERED” they aren’t fully gone from us. Being given the safe space to talk about them and their life and the things they loved — for as much as you want — honors them too. So, if it doesn’t hurt too much OP and only if you want to — tell us more about what made her so amazing. I love the pics you posted of her. You really captured her beautiful spirit so well in a few photos. Hugs, 🫂 fren.
